visualReview.notes: The oblique and side captures show the connected four-part temple, the tall curved Vimana, the two distinct stepped roofs and the low flat dance hall. The front gate camera shows the portal void, layered cap and freestanding Aruna Stambha.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: The current material renders retain separate ashlar foundations, warm gray sandstone moldings, shaded stone and the wheel above the crown. The geographic flat-terrain view tests placement and material binding; actual wall contact was reviewed on the independent original elevation field.

mediumFiReview.notes: The four levels carry the Vimana, all three lower halls, perimeter and gate silhouettes. The street and close levels resolve ratha divisions, masonry courses, layered roof steps, parapet teeth, gate openings and the metal crown and banner.

geographicReview.notes: The four current mapped gates and outer enclosure fix the model position and axis. The four hall footprints are registered from Hunter's survey. A 380 m original Terrarium field was inspected without a mask, replacement or ground cutout. The public approach controls vertical registration; courtyard and plinth levels are approximate.

fidelityReview.scope: Existing four axial halls of Jagannath Temple in Puri, the outer Meghanada Prachir wall, the four cardinal gates and the Aruna Stambha outside the Lion Gate.
fidelityReview.notes: The cleared Qualla gate photo supplies the Lion Gate and pillar. Two original 1872 plates bind the hall order, stepped versus curved roof profiles, and exterior axis. The temple authority's descriptions and height establish the modern scope. Decoration, minor roof heights and terrace thresholds are generalized.

imageryReview.notes: The original British Library Lion Gate image published on Qualla matches the Commons first upload and public-domain markings. An exact public-domain scan of Hunter's 1872 volume, checked against its title page and original plates, supplements the gate photo. Attribution-conditioned and unclear references were excluded.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: Jagannath Temple's four principal halls in Puri, the outer Meghanada Prachir wall, four cardinal gates and the Aruna Stambha.

limitations: Outer walls and gate centers follow mapped geometry. The main halls use an approximate registration of the 1872 survey across the east and west gates; hall corners, offsets and remodeling are not a current survey.

The approximately 65 m overall height follows the temple administration measurement above ground. Individual hall roof heights and decorative stonework, metal wheel, flag and stone gate sculpture are expressed at medium detail.
Terrain is an unchanged sampled Terrarium field. Architectural plinths and steps are modeled separately; precise threshold and terrace datums are estimated.
The four main halls and outer precinct are included. Interior rooms, minor shrines, the inner enclosure and newer amenities are outside this model scope.
